description: This file defines the 'Services' class within the WPEFramework::Broadcast namespace, which manages DVB service information, including scanning, service listing, and notification handling related to tuner state changes and DVB SDT (Service Description Table) processing.

classes.name: Services
classes.description: Manages DVB services, including scanning, service list management, and DVB SDT processing.

classes.name: Services::Sink
classes.description: Implements ITuner::INotification to handle tuner activation, deactivation, and state changes.

classes.name: Services::Parser
classes.description: Handles DVB SDT section filtering and processing.

classes.name: Services::Service
classes.description: Represents individual DVB service information, including service ID, name, and status flags.

methods.name: Services::Scan
methods.description: Starts or stops scanning for DVB services.

methods.name: Services::Id
methods.description: Retrieves a specific service by its ID.

methods.name: Services::List
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the list of available services.

methods.name: Services::Load
methods.description: Loads DVB SDT data into the service list.
